verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents its own background automation for the identity lifecycle: automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows, HRIS-driven provisioning and deprovisioning with minimal manual intervention, and automated identity creation, access changes and termination. These are scoped lifecycle workflows rather than a general way for users to build their own background automations. The API and PowerShell bulk operations are developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: user-configurable general automation or workflow builder, scheduling or trigger configuration docs, any AI- or agent-driven autonomous execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
